title: AI Browser Game Jam 6: Dec 18 to Jan 3 - Use any AI tools, 317 entries last round!
author: Slackluster
selftext:
AI Browser Game Jam 6 is open for sign-ups. The jam runs **December 18 2026 to January 3rd 2027**.

The rules are simple: make a free browser-playable game in two weeks using AI for whatever you want - code, art, music, design, sound, anything.

**A few details:**

* No required AI service
* Solo devs or teams
* Theme revealed when the jam starts
* Theme is optional
* Sharing your AI workflow/process is encouraged
* Keep working on your game during voting
* Participants play and rate the entries

The last jam had **317 entries and 421 people joined**, so I’m really curious how big round 6 gets.

Jam page: [https://itch.io/jam/ai-jam-6](https://itch.io/jam/ai-jam-6)

Discord: [https://discord.gg/86xBnZqHjy](https://discord.gg/86xBnZqHjy)

If you joined one of the previous jams, feel free to share what you made and what tools you used. Thanks for reading and have nice day.
